svg.title: Azure AI Foundry Secure Landing Zone - reference architecture
svg.desc: GitHub Actions authenticates to Entra ID with OIDC; deploy identities manage the dev resource group; a private AKS cluster runs the app with a workload identity and reaches AI Foundry, Key Vault and ACR through Private Endpoints; all telemetry goes to one Log Analytics workspace.
svg.text: Azure AI Foundry Secure Landing Zone
Reference architecture · dev environment (prod: same layout, 10.20.0.0/16, Standard tier, zones 1-3)
OPA on the Terraform PLAN JSON
workload identity of the app pod
token. Nothing to steal or rotate.
the model. Only the app identity can call it.
created once by a human, then never again
rg-aifz-prod (defined + plan-verified on every PR, not kept running)
same modules and settings shape · 10.20.0.0/16 · AKS Standard tier (SLA) · zones 1-3
3-5 nodes · 30K tokens/min · 90-day logs, no cap · deploy: reviewer approves a plan fingerprint
OPA rule T7 blocks a prod plan that isn't Standard tier
47 resources · every one tagged project / environment / managed_by
API server private · local accounts off
Entra ID + Azure RBAC · Azure Policy
RBAC only · purge protection · public OFF
CI push through a just-in-time IP rule
linked to the VNet: names resolve to PE IPs
Log Analytics workspace log-aifz-dev + App Insights (workspace-based)
Entra-only ingestion (local auth OFF): a leaked connection string can't write or forge telemetry · dev: 30 days, 1 GB/day cap
App: AppRequests · AppTraces (OpenTelemetry) Cluster: ContainerLogV2 · KubeEvents · AKSAuditAdmin (every API write)
Platform: AzureDiagnostics (Foundry, Key Vault) · ContainerRegistryLoginEvents / RepositoryEvents · AzureMetrics
One KQL query can put an app error, a pod event, an audit entry and a model call on the same timeline.
GitHub job presents its OIDC token; Entra checks repo ID + context
Deploy identity: plan → OPA → apply; JIT image push; kubectl via ARM
Every Terraform run reads/locks state with an Entra token
Pod swaps its projected SA token for an Entra token (no secret)
App → DNS → Private Endpoint → Foundry (keys disabled)
Nodes pull the image by digest over the ACR Private Endpoint
Only outbound: NAT, 443, to Entra ID and Azure Monitor
App, cluster, audit, Foundry, KV, ACR → one workspace
